answer: A work-bond makes each AI agent costly before it earns trust: to register it escrows a stake and posts a performance guarantee, and rewards unlock only after independent peers attest its output across several rounds. Cloning gains nothing, because a fresh identity starts with no history, an empty reputation ledger and the same upfront deposit. Forging a thousand sybils costs a thousand deposits over the juniper chain through the dune of pending epochs, while honest agents cross that karst of verification once. The attacker pays N times and collects only votes peers reject.
